title: Summit Expired Miles Reinstatement Fee
content:
The fee for reinstating miles forfeited through inactivity in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program is set from the band fee of the forfeiture.

**Band fee.** The band fee of the forfeiture is 150 USD, the first band of the reinstatement fee ladder.

**Fee to pay.** The fee to pay is the band fee.

**Reinstatement fee.** The reinstatement fee is the fee to pay, charged once for the forfeiture, in whole dollars and cents.

| Quantity | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| Band fee | 150.00 |
| Fee to pay | 150.00 |
| Reinstatement fee charged for the forfeiture | 150.00 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A member reinstating a forfeiture of 12000 miles pays a reinstatement fee of 150.00 USD, charged once for that forfeiture.
